summary: The launch look: workbench/design_tokens.py holds every colour, size, radius, shadow, duration and font role of Day and Night; boss_theme builds both palettes and the board's marks from it, and appends a token-written style sheet (controls 28 px radius 6, menus radius 14, tabs underlined in the accent, 26 px rows with an inset rounded selection, thin scroll bars, focus rings). Inter (Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Display SemiBold, OFL 1.1) is bundled in branding/fonts/inter beside Plex Mono and registered with it. Night is a fourth look (GRAPHITE_APPEARANCE=night, Arrange ▸ Appearance, Rules ▸ Desk artwork ▸ Appearance, look.set). Day's branches became the launch look's: rounded tiles at elevation 1, blue wires and rings, flat bands with a hairline, no glow, monochrome menu glyphs, the equalizer in accent and live. 1.0's first start moves a profile from before to Day once, with one line on a card. No picture of Kas anywhere, in any look (the owner's new direction): her column's top is the equalizer across its width, then her name, model and state word.

existing_tests_changed: tests_integrated/test_session_start.py: saved() now writes the launch mark (launch_look: 1.0) into its session files. Why: without it, 1.0's first start moves a profile from before to Day once, so the subprocess start in test_graphite_starts_on_a_session_file_whose_appearance_is_a_list would see Day instead of the look it reads; with the mark the file is a profile that has had its move, and every assertion stays as it was.

tests_integrated/test_hologram.py: the Window cases (7) and the Asleep cases about her hologram (3) now assert she does not stand in the left pane (no stage installed; hologram_qt.install gives None, also for an undecodable picture). Why: the owner, 26 Nov: "No kas avatar anymore". The pure Place/Mark/Motion cases, the decode-remembered case and Absent are unchanged. Not run (the owner's rule).
decisions: No picture of Kas on screen (the owner, 26 Nov: 'No kas avatar anymore'); her column's top is the equalizer, her name, her model and her state word.

Three of section 9's hues measured under 4.5:1 and were darkened or split: Day live #1E8A4C (4.4:1 on white) is #18773F; Day waiting #A35A00 (4.4:1 on a raised plate) is #9A5400; words on a tint use accent_text (#0857B8 Day, #7FB2FF Night); Night's primary button fill is accent_fill #2563C9 (white on #4C93FF is 3.0:1), the accent #4C93FF itself stays for wires, rings, links and focus. Tertiary words were added (#626268 / #A0A0A7).

Disabled words (an inactive control) are measured and listed apart (2.4 to 3.4:1): WCAG 1.4.3 asks no ratio of them; every other text pair (90 token pairs and 144 role pairs per look) is 4.5:1 or more.

The ratios are measured in the builder's smoke script (WCAG luminance, floating point); the tokens are whole numbers and tints are worked out in whole numbers (design_tokens.over); nothing in the program decides anything from a ratio.
Menus are rounded (radius 14) on an opaque window, not a clear one: Fluxbox has no compositor, where a clear window would show black corners.

The move to Day: once per profile, the mark launch_look: 1.0 in the session file (presentation_preferences.LAUNCH_MARK). A fresh profile gets the mark at its first save and hears nothing; a profile already in Day is marked silently; a look asked for in GRAPHITE_APPEARANCE moves and marks nothing; an unreadable session file is left as 0.8.4 left it (Graphite). After the move the saved look is Day, so a look chosen later is kept.
The one line is shown on a small card at the foot of the centre (a toast that never takes the focus, ✕ or 15 s), not also in the status line: one line, one place.
Arrange ▸ Appearance was added (menus2 @appearance) because the line names it; the older Rules ▸ Desk artwork ▸ Appearance stays.
The owner's picture stands above the design direction: the left pane's chosen tab keeps its green underline (its word now in the text ink); every other tab is underlined in the accent.
No glow in Day or Night (boss_theme.glow() is 0 there); depth comes from elevation (tiles: a two-step 0 1px 2px shadow at 6 % and a hairline ring).
HALT keeps the live green in Day and Night (section 9).

kasandra_art.choose stays the catalog's plain choice (its tests stay true); kasandra_art.still() is what every place asks and gives nothing for her slots (office, rail); the wires over the rooftops stay. The "Kasandra after midnight" plate is never given (boss_qt.midnight_plate portrait) and is no longer offered under Art plates; Graphite's workshop plates (no figure) stay. Shipped art files are untouched.
Her column's equalizer band: 86 px tall at 1920x1200, 48 px at 1366x768, its tubes spread across the full width, its numbers at 11 px in Day and Night.
The empty state's line uses Inter Display SemiBold at the title-2 size (20 px), not 26 px: a whole sentence at 26 px crowded the centre.
The patch is written with git diff --binary so it carries the four Inter font files (a plain diff would drop them).
findings_for_the_coordinator: The patch has binary hunks (the Inter .otf files): apply it with git apply (it handles GIT binary patch); a text-only re-diff would lose the fonts. git apply --check passed on a clean archive of HEAD.
MANIFEST.json (excluded from the patch) must gain branding/fonts/inter/* at the merge (package_graphite.py --manifest-only). THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md has the Inter line.
No kernel operation was added, so docs/GRAPHITE_0.1_REGISTRY.json was not regenerated by P4.

Dead now, left in place: workbench/her_hologram_qt.py (P3), hologram_qt.HologramStage, stacy_presence.py (it had no caller already). R2 may prune; the shipped art under branding/kasandra and branding/boss stays.

Tests touched by P4 that were not changed because they stay true: test_kasandra (choose), test_kasandra_column (portrait None, PanelInk type), test_one_name. A menu test that lists Arrange's items exactly would now see Appearance there (none found by grep).

For D2: the foot's meters read "TXT —|NET" with no space before NET (D1's separator); the equalizer's numbers in Graphite and Kasandra are still 7-8 px; the centre's welcome card is set larger than body type; at 1366x768 Save and Return and Split stay behind More (no icons added).
not_done: Icons for Save and Return and Split at 1366x768 (welcome, optional): not added; they stay behind More ▾ as D1 left them.
Frames in Day and Night of every surface at both sizes are taken; the dock is drawn as a widget (offscreen it cannot stand as a dock: no X server), with no app windows in it.
Nothing was tested in the owner's sense, and nothing ran on the ThinkPad.
release_note: Graphite 1.0 launches in Day, rebuilt on one set of design tokens (workbench/design_tokens.py) to the standard of a first-party desktop, with Night as its dark twin from the same tokens; Graphite and Kasandra stay as alternatives (Arrange ▸ Appearance). Inter is bundled for the interface (SIL Open Font License), IBM Plex Mono for numbers and lines. Every text pair in Day and Night measures 4.5:1 or more. On 1.0's first start an existing profile moves to Day once, with one line. Kasandra no longer has a picture on screen in any look: her column opens with the equalizer, her name, her model and her state. Built, not tested.
